items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: That's Charlie. That's the boy. And that's me. ... I see that band. That's the part of the band of Chanty, New York.

ctx.x: Yeah. Oh, yeah. Yeah, this here. This joint. Yeah, that's right. That's right. Yeah. Is that Cordello? Yeah, that's Charlie. Oh, yeah. That's how he had it burned in.
